name.basis: the firm's site and brand; legal name Speedinvest GmbH (Firmenbuch FN 363581d, Vienna; formerly Speed Invest GmbH and Speed Invest Management GmbH), an SEC exempt reporting adviser (CRD 316774).

founding_year.basis: Speedinvest GmbH was registered on 2011-05-26 (Firmenbuch FN 363581d via North Data); the firm's own post of 2022-12-14: 'In 2011, with just €10 million AuM, Speedinvest already had six full-time partners'; Form ADV Schedule A dates both founding partners to 05/2011.

history.value: Speedinvest was founded in Vienna in 2011 by Oliver Holle and a group of former founders, starting with a €10 million fund from more than 30 private investors. It became known for early bets on Shpock, Bitpanda, GoStudent, TIER and Wayflyer, and grew into sector teams across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Its fourth flagship fund closed at €350 million in 2024, and the firm manages more than €1.2 billion.
history.basis: founding: the firm's 2012 home page ('Up to 500.000 Euro in capital, from our 10 million Investment Fund, coming from over 30 private investors ... Oliver Holle, Founder', Common Crawl capture of 2012-05-19) and its 2022-12-14 post ('six full-time partners (all former startup operators)'). Bets: Shpock (2011, sold 2015), Bitpanda, GoStudent, TIER and Wayflyer are all in the portfolio; the firm's 2022 post names Bitpanda, GoStudent, Open, TIER, Wayflyer and wefox as its unicorns. Today: the firm's posts of 2024-01-31 ('final €350 million close of Speedinvest 4 ... total AuM of more than €1 billion') and 2026-03-25 ('over €1.2 billion under management'). Left out to fit, kept here: Speedinvest II (over EUR 90M, 2015-12-09) and III (EUR 190M, 2020-02-25); the vertical funds Speedinvest F (fintech), Industry and x (Network Effects, launched January 2018, second fund 2020); the 2022 follow-on vehicles (EUR 250M, Opportunity I and Industry & Climate Opportunity); two continuation vehicles (EUR 60M, 2025); the Middle East & Africa fund launched in 2026; offices in Berlin, London, Munich, Paris and Abu Dhabi, and a Silicon Valley office from 2011 to about 2020; NEA's 2016 investment in Fund II. Boundary notes a reader does not need: the firm lists eight acquirers that paid for portfolio companies in shares (OpenAI, Mistral, MoonPay, Perk, Mews, Dialpad, Taxfix, OneTrust), which are not counted; the acquired companies are.

investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement: the homepage h1 'The Power of More', read 2026-09-30, set in sentence case with a closing period. Competing lines: the title tag 'European & Global Pre-Seed to Growth VC Fund: Backing Tech Startups' and the how-we-work headline 'Many move more.'

investment_stage.basis: the firm's own words: 'Investing in pre-seed, seed and growth-stage companies across Europe and beyond'; 'Early: Inception to Seed, €250K - €5M; Growth: Series B to Pre-IPO, €5M - €30M'. Series A is added from behaviour, flagged: the landed entry rounds include Series A entries the firm's wording does not name.

investment_geo.basis: the firm's own footprint line 'Europe and Beyond' and its Middle East, Africa & Beyond team (Abu Dhabi office; a dedicated fund launched 2026); the landed base is mostly Germany, the UK, France and Austria, with rows in the UAE, Kenya, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Nigeria and Egypt. Two-label cap on core.

investment_range.basis: lower limit: the firm's stated early cheque 'Inception to Seed €250K - €5M': EUR 250,000 @ ECB 2026-09-30 (EUR/USD 1.1355) = $283,875. Upper limit: its growth cheque 'Series B to Pre-IPO €5M - €30M': EUR 30.0M @ ECB 2026-09-30 (EUR/USD 1.1355) = $34.1M. Median: the entry rounds whose size the record states on 194 portfolio rows (scratch/entry-round-sizes.json): $3.5M; this is a round size, not the firm's cheque, and it is press-based (the Form D histories cover a handful of rows).

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first (PRO-152). Considered next: Wayflyer, Curve, CoachHub, Shpock, Billie.

aum.basis: both ends: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of the firm's one exempt reporting adviser, SPEEDINVEST GMBH (CRD 316774, SEC 802-126139, annual amendment of 2026-04-01; sources/registers/adv-7b.json): Speedinvest IV EuVECA $446,841,378; III EuVECA $330,043,090; Opportunity I EuVECA $242,401,405; II EuVECA $139,643,382; F EuVECA $91,536,882; Industry & Climate Opportunity EuVECA $66,797,620; Emerging Markets $33,999,013; Initial Factor Speed Invest (Fund I) $30,552,489; Co-Invest UVG $27,597,851; Co-Invest MA $2,082,904 = $1,411,496,014. The filing lists ten of the firm's vehicles (a non-US exempt reporting adviser reports the funds it lists); the Austrian register carries more (Speedinvest V, Growth II, Industry, x and x II, f II, AI Opportunities I, further co-investment and two continuation vehicles), so the sworn figure is a floor. The firm's own 'over €1.2 billion under management' (2026-03-25 post; EUR 1.20B @ ECB 2026-03-25 (EUR/USD 1.1592) = $1.39B) sits just below it and stays in this note.

funds.basis: Speedinvest IV: EUR 350.0M final close (the firm's post, 2024-01-31; first close December 2022) @ ECB 2024-01-31 (EUR/USD 1.0837) = $379.3M. Speedinvest III: EUR 190.0M (the firm's post, 2020-02-24/25) @ ECB 2020-02-25 (EUR/USD 1.084) = $206.0M. Speedinvest II: 'über 90 Millionen Euro' at the final closing (the firm's release of 2015-12-09, Common Crawl capture) EUR 90.0M @ ECB 2015-12-09 (EUR/USD 1.0941) = $98.5M. Speedinvest I: 'our 10 million Investment Fund' (the firm's 2012 home page; Initial Factor Speed Invest GmbH & Co KG, registered 2011-07-20) EUR 10.0M @ ECB 2011-07-20 (EUR/USD 1.4207) = $14.2M. No entry carries a Form D accession: the three 2023 Form Ds (Speedinvest IV, Opportunity I, Industry & Climate Opportunity) report only the amounts sold to US investors. Not listed, for want of a firm-stated size: Speedinvest F, Industry, x and x II (the firm's 2020 x II release was a first close), Emerging Markets, Opportunity I and Growth II; the 2022 follow-on vehicles raised EUR 250M together; co-investment, continuation and GPC vehicles are plumbing.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: Nordbergstrasse 1/1/71, Vienna, Austria (SPEEDINVEST GMBH, CRD 316774, Annual Amendment filed 2026-04-01).
